summary: Add observational provider quota and durable credit evidence for account-limit displays and CAM-R01/CAM-R02 SLOs without changing harness scheduling or enforcement.

replay.detail: The new replicated durable usage.limits.observed kind is retained independently of local writer configuration. Older members quarantine the unknown non-authority kind for replay after upgrade. Latest quota and credit observations are projected per producer; configured writers are selected at read time.

schema.detail: The account-limit projection upgrades from version 2 to 3 and rebuilds from durable claims. A rebuildable latest-credit projection avoids replaying durable credit history on each SLO read.

rules.detail: retention.toml declares usage.limits.observed durable with no checkpoint pruning rule; producer evidence remains available for configuration changes and projection rebuilds.

compatibility.detail: The optional [usage_limits] daemon configuration section accepts a writers list. Empty or absent writers deny local producer appends and show no producer evidence, while schema-valid replication remains accepted. The producer must write as its configured agent identity. Harness scheduling and enforcement continue to use harness-only evidence.

downtime.detail: No coordinated fleet restart or capability gate is required. A member catches up its local derived projections when opening the upgraded store.

manual.detail: Configure [usage_limits] writers with explicitly authorized producer agent identities to enable local publication and observational displays; restart the daemon after changing configuration.

recovery.detail: Before rolling back to an older binary with strict configuration parsers, remove the [usage_limits] section. Durable observations remain stored; derived quota and credit projections can be rebuilt after upgrading again.
